user.title: PM Push
user.description: PM Push connects Home Assistant with the PM HomeControl app: notifications, CallKit calls and Live Activities. Push runs through the PM Networks service; nothing to enter. Each iPhone with PM HomeControl then registers itself.

abort.single_instance_allowed: PM Push is already set up.

data.nahe_zonen: Zones that count as home (no door call)
data.kritisch_anruf: Critical notifications also as a call
